During the [[Galactic War]], a '''rebellion''' carried out by [[Slavery|enslaved]] individuals took place on [[Da Soocha]]. Unnoticed by their masters, the enslaved individuals overthrew their cruel oppressors.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Shattering Their Chains}}</ref>
